description: Synthetic customer-support knowledge base. Each context mimics a RAG prompt stuffed with a system preamble, repeated boilerplate, and unrelated sections. Each question has a gold fact that must survive compression, plus paraphrases a real user might send.

contexts.text:
You are a helpful support assistant for Acme Cloud, an internal SaaS product.
Company boilerplate: Always be polite. Always be clear. Always be concise.
Company boilerplate: Always be polite. Always be clear. Always be concise.
Company boilerplate: Always be polite. Always be clear. Always be concise.

Password reset policy:
Users can reset a password from the account login page by clicking Forgot Password.
The reset link expires after 30 minutes.
Administrators cannot view user passwords.
After five failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.

Two-factor authentication:
Two-factor authentication can be enabled under Settings, then Security.
Supported second factors are authenticator apps and hardware security keys.
SMS codes are not supported for security reasons.

Account deletion:
Account owners can delete a workspace from Settings, then Danger Zone.
Deleted workspaces are recoverable for 14 days before permanent removal.

Unrelated release notes:
The dashboard color palette changed last quarter.
The marketing page headline was updated.
The mobile app icon now uses a darker shade of blue.
Our annual conference will be held in Lisbon this year.

Company boilerplate: Always be polite. Always be clear. Always be concise.

Never share internal pricing spreadsheets with customers.

Invoices:
Invoices are generated on the first day of each month.
Invoices can be downloaded as PDF from Billing, then History.
The billing contact receives invoices by email.

Refunds:
Refund requests must include the invoice number.
Refunds are processed within 10 business days.
Annual plans can be refunded on a prorated basis within the first 30 days.

Plan changes:
Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated for the current cycle.
Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle.
The Starter plan includes up to 5 seats.
The Business plan includes single sign-on and audit logs.

Payment methods:
We accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express.
Enterprise customers can pay by bank transfer with net 30 terms.

Unrelated release notes:
The dashboard color palette changed last quarter.
Our support team added two new members in the Berlin office.
The status page moved to a new domain.

contexts.text:
You are a developer support assistant for the Acme Cloud public API.
Company boilerplate: Always be polite. Always be clear. Always be concise.
Company boilerplate: Always be polite. Always be clear. Always be concise.
Always include code samples when relevant.
Always include code samples when relevant.

Authentication:
API requests are authenticated with a bearer token in the Authorization header.
API tokens can be created under Settings, then Developer.
Tokens do not expire but can be revoked at any time.

Rate limits:
The API allows 600 requests per minute per token.
Requests over the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
Bulk endpoints count as ten requests each.

Pagination:
List endpoints return 100 items per page by default.
Use the cursor field from the response to fetch the next page.

Webhooks:
Webhook deliveries are retried up to 8 times with exponential backoff.
Each webhook request is signed with an HMAC SHA-256 signature header.

Unrelated release notes:
The dashboard color palette changed last quarter.
The documentation site switched to a new search provider.
The community forum now supports dark mode.
